[[File:Ultimo.png|thumb|250px|Ultimo]] '''Ultimo''' (Japanese: '''ウルティモ''' ''Ultimo'') is a minor recurring character in {{aniseries|PTS}}. He first appeared in ''[[BW103|Curtain Up, Unova League!]]'', where he participated in the [[Vertress Conference]] and was [[Virgil]]'s first opponent. Their battle began off-screen. Ultimo attempted to keep distance between his Pokémon and Virgil's {{p|Vaporeon}} to make up for Crustle's slower speed. He blocked an oncoming {{m|Hydro Pump}} with {{m|Rock Wrecker}}, but Crustle was later hit by several direct attacks. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', Ultimo was defeated by Virgil and subsequently eliminated from the tournament. ==Pokémon== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ultimo |pkmn=Crustle |img=Ultimo Crustle.png |type1=Bug |type2=Rock |epnum=BW103 |epname=Curtain Up, Unova League! |vajp=Unshō Ishizuka |vaen=Tom Wayland |desc={{p|Crustle}} is the first Pokémon Ultimo is known to have on hand. It was used in the first round of the Vertress Conference, going up against [[Virgil]]'s {{p|Vaporeon}}. In ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', it was defeated by Vaporeon. Crustle's known moves are {{m|X-Scissor}} and {{m|Rock Wrecker}}.}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Ultimo |pkmn=Dwebble |img=Ramone Tranquill.png |type1=Bug |type2=Rock |epnum=BW104 |epname=Mission: Defeat Your Rival! |desc={{p|Dwebble}} was seen briefly with Ultimo in front of a Pokémon Center in ''[[BW104|Mission: Defeat Your Rival!]]'', after he was eliminated from the [[Vertress Conference]].
